title: What Renting Guide Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of renting guide: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Renting well: budget 30% of income, tour in person, read the lease, document move-in condition, and know your tenant rights. Renters insurance ($15-$25/mo) is essential.

Why it matters: Rent <= 30% of gross income is the standard Landlords typically want income 3x rent

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Renting Guide
summary: Start renting guide this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set budget (30% rule)
2. List needs vs wants
3. Tour in person, day and evening
4. Read the entire lease
5. Negotiate (rent, parking, move-in date)

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Renting Guide Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common renting guide questions.
body:
Q: Can I negotiate rent?
A: Yes - especially longer leases or off-season.

Q: What fees are normal?
A: Application $30-$75; deposits vary by state law.

Q: Breaking a lease?
A: Read the clause; often 1-2 months' rent.
